newsitem.title: USA: Overland sees Q3 earnings below co's view.
newsitem.headline: Overland sees Q3 earnings below co's view.

text.p: Overland Data Inc said it anticipates that third quarter earnings will be slightly below its internal forecast.
The company did not say what that forcast was.

Overland issued a statement saying it has been notified by Quantum Corp that Quantum's new DLT7000 drives are on allocation, and that shipments are expected to be significantly less than the quantities ordered by the company to meet its currently projected requirements.
Quantum is the sole supplier of the DLT7000 drive which is used in one of the products within Overland's LibraryXpress family of automated tape libraries, Overland said.
Overland said it was told by Quantum that the supply problems are primarily attributable to the high level of market demand which exceeds Quantum's current production capacity.

Overland said it anticipates that this allocation could adversely affect up to $1 million and $4 million of sales for its third quarter ending March 31, 1997 and fourth quarter ending June 30, 1997, respectively.
